requirement: Desktop first-run follow-ups: a refused sign-in says why, Cancel ends the round on the server, the connected AI account is the pick and never gets a not-installed card

oracle.ref: PR #1176 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/desktop-onboard-v2/dev-acceptance/README.md (findings 3 and 4, dev acceptance of #1166)
oracle.invariant: Refused exchange shows the reason: GET /login?onboard=1&reason=not-admitted draws the whitelist alert; expired/denied/failed draw 'The sign-in did not finish. Try again.'; an unknown reason draws nothing and is not echoed; the app maps a 403 SIGN_IN_REFUSED/NOT_ADMITTED redeem to /login?reason=not-admitted and keeps onboard=1 on a first run. Cancel flips the round: POST /auth/link/:nonce/cancel with the round's clientSecret answers 204, the poll reads denied, a later /signin/approve answers 400 and the session redeem 404; wrong secret, lane round and approved round are untouched; the app sends the cancel once with the secret only in the body. The not-installed card is absent when the picked vendor is connected. A connected account is preselected over the scan's pick (the one in status.next first), sits in the main grid, and the panel shows data-connect=connected with no [data-warn].
